description: Korean VAT: general vs simplified taxpayer (부가가치세법). Simplified allowed under 104M KRW annual sales including VAT (48M for real-estate rental etc.), pays sales × sector value-added rate (15-40%) × 10% − 0.5% of purchases, no refunds, exempt under 48M; general pays output − input VAT and can get refunds. Both get the 1.3% card-sales credit (cap 10M). Returns both taxes, which is cheaper, eligibility and the tax invoice duty.

cardShare.description: Share of sales paid by card or cash receipt (0-1)

purchases.description: Annual purchases with tax invoices or cards, including VAT (KRW)

sector.description: retail = retail and restaurants 15%; manufacturing 20%; lodging 25%; construction = construction, transport, ICT 30%; service = other services 30%; professional = professional services, finance, real estate 40%
